2609.28358.title: MicroQonv: Reshaping Convolution Tensors for Efficient Microscaling in Training and Inference
2609.28358.paper_summary: Microscaling quantization techniques are increasingly used to represent neural network parameters with 8 bits or fewer while preserving near-full precision accuracy. However, applying these methods efficiently in convolutional layers is not straightforward. A naive approach transfers full-precision weights and activations to processing units and quantizes each tensor twice, resulting in much more memory movement than expected. Additional overhead comes from the activation tensors, whose sizes grow substantially because of the im2col transformation applied before quantization. We propose MicroQonv, a way to combine microscaling with convolutional layers' forward and backward operations by quantizing each tensor only once and quantizing the activation tensor before applying a modified version of im2col: channel-batch-first im2col. MicroQonv reduces the quantization cost by a factor of $\times2$ for weights and gradients, and by up to $\times9$ for activations, at a negligible accuracy cost. It reduces memory movement and storage by up to $\times7.53$ compared to their full-precision counterparts. This way, MicroQonv reduces microscaling-quantized activation memory movement by $\times3.5$ for state-of-the-art object detection models YOLOV8nano and $\times2.2$ for YOLOV26nano. It also enables 4-bit microscaling in a quantized latent replay strategy for continual learning at the edge, improving accuracy by +5.7% to +11%.
2609.28358.paper_summary_zh: 微縮量化技術越來越多地被用來以 8 位元或更少的方式表示神經網絡參數，同時保持接近全精度的準確性。<lb/>然而，在卷積層中高效地應用這些方法並不簡單。<lb/>一種天真的方法是將全精度的權重和激活轉移到處理單元，並對每個張量進行兩次量化，這導致了比預期更多的內存移動。<lb/>額外的開銷來自於激活張量，其大小因在量化之前應用的 im2col 轉換而大幅增長。<lb/>我們提出了 MicroQonv，這是一種將微縮與卷積層的前向和後向操作結合的方法，通過僅對每個張量進行一次量化，並在應用修改版的 im2col（通道-批次-優先 im2col）之前對激活張量進行量化。<lb/>MicroQonv 將權重和梯度的量化成本降低了 $\times2$，而激活的量化成本降低了最多 $\times9$，且準確性損失微乎其微。<lb/>與全精度的對應物相比，它將內存移動和存儲減少了最多 $\times7.53$。<lb/>通過這種方式，MicroQonv 對於最先進的物體檢測模型 YOLOV8nano 減少了 $\times3.5$ 的微縮量化激活內存移動，對於 YOLOV26nano 減少了 $\times2.2$。<lb/>它還在邊緣的量化潛在重播策略中啟用了 4 位元的微縮量化，將準確性提高了 +5.7% 到 +11%。
